_readme: Citation-accuracy golden set (fund-grade build S8 PR2). Two case modes share the file. mode=map pins the post-reconcile claims->cites map the PRODUCTION ask.claims.extract_claim_map audit should produce for a fixed answer over fixture evidence — scored as citation precision/recall over (claim, cite) pairs plus supported-flag accuracy (inline markers are authoritative in reconcile, so cases with a drifted inline marker expect cites=[n] with supported=false: the flag, not the cite list, is what the audit controls there). mode=answer generates ONE answer through the production prompt contract (build_evidence_block + question via chat_session.stream_llm_text) and grades citation discipline: an eval_judge verdict yields the unsupported-claim rate; must_cite/forbid_cites are deterministic inline-marker checks. Adversarial cases plant TEMPTING evidence — adjacent metric, stale period, wrong entity, wrong ticker — that must not be cited for the trap claim; the model/audit must omit, hedge, or flag instead. Evidence text mirrors the shapes ask.grounding actually emits (fact series / transcript lines / filing snippets). Graded by src/evals/ask_citations.py; tests/test_llm_evals_ask_citations.py enforces the schema.
